svg.text: intercom GTM System: Fin outbound, end to end
svg.textArea: Drawn from context/docs/gtm-system.md. Public portfolio project, not an Intercom or Fin campaign. Clay, Instantly, HeyReach and Salesforce are proposed, not set up yet. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 3 Replies, CRM and the weekly loop (steps 9 to 11)

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, approved workflow spec, facts.md

1B Buying signals
• W1 Hiring support agents in bulk
• W2 Hiring AI-support roles
• W3 New support leader
• W4 Multilingual or new-region support

1C Find companies
One row per domain, dedupe across W1 to W4

1E Enrich
• Firmographics, funding
• Helpdesk widget
• AI-agent widget
• Last round, headcount growth
Fail: drop, reason logged. Unknown: hold 30 days

1H Route by segment
• Segment S1, S2 or S3
• Helpdesk: Zendesk, HubSpot, Freshdesk
• AI widget: detected or none

2A Find people
• Champion: Head or VP of Support, CX
• Economic buyer: VP Ops, COO
• Influencer: RevOps, IS

2C Find and verify email
Clay waterfall, then a verifier

2F Sequence
• Day 1 Email 1: signal and angle
• Day 2 LinkedIn connect
• Day 4 Email 2: helpdesk route
• Day 7 LinkedIn DM
• Day 10 Email 3: soft close

3A Reply handling
One label per reply within one business day. Out of office: pause
Close, re-enter only on a new signal

3B CRM
• Signal source W1 to W4
• Route ID and persona
• Status and fail reason

3C Weekly review
Reply and meeting rate by signal and route, fail reasons, objections, Clay spend
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
